auth.subtitle: Morning. Intention. Evening. Review.
auth.name: Name
auth.switchToSignin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.demoNote: Demo mode: data lives only in this browser. Connect Supabase cloud — see docs/10-supabase-setup.md.
auth.cloudNote: ☁ Cloud mode: data is stored in Supabase and synced across devices.
auth.checkEmail: 📬 Email sent! Check the Spam folder. If nothing arrives within 10 minutes, disable email confirmation in Supabase (Authentication → Email → “Confirm email”) and just sign in — your account is already created.
auth.errorPassword: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.errorCredentials: Wrong email or password — or the account does not exist yet. If this is your first time, click “No account? Sign up” below. If you forgot the password, use “Forgot password?” on the right.
auth.errorExists: A user with this email already exists — just sign in below.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
auth.errorNotConfirmed: Email is not confirmed yet. Open the Supabase email (check Spam too), click the confirmation link, then sign in.
auth.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a bit (usually up to an hour) and try again — or use a different email.
auth.errorSignupsDisabled: New signups are disabled in Supabase settings (Authentication → Sign In / Providers → “Allow new users to sign up”).
auth.errorDbUser: The database could not save the user. Make sure the SQL from step 3 of the guide was run in the SQL Editor — and send me this error text.
auth.demoNoReset: This is demo mode (no cloud): just create a new account.
auth.forgotHint: Enter the email you registered with. We will send a link to reset your password.
auth.checkResetEmail: 📬 Email sent! Open it (check Spam if needed) and click the reset link.
auth.passwordChanged: ✓ Password updated. Now sign in with the new password.
auth.cloudFail: ⚠ Could not verify the cloud connection. Try signing up anyway; if it fails — check your internet and reload the page.

errors.sync: Could not save changes to the cloud. Check your connection and try again.

onboarding.step1d: A daily quote, an intention and three main tasks. The day starts consciously, not with notifications.
onboarding.step2d: Tasks marked the Stoic way: “up to me” or “not up to me”. Energy goes only where you make a difference.
onboarding.step3d: Seneca's four questions: what went well, what was outside your control, what you learned, what you're grateful for.

today.obstaclesPh: What may get in the way? How will I respond?
today.morningDoneSub: Have a good day. See you in the evening.
today.eveningDoneSub: The day is closed. The entry went to your journal.
today.skippedNote: Morning skipped — that is practice too. Start right with the evening.
today.reminderMorningBanner: Time for the morning ritual: your intention and main tasks.
today.reminderEveningBanner: Time for the evening review: four questions — and the day is closed.

journal.title: Journal
journal.privacy: Your journal is visible only to you — enforced at the database level
journal.contentPh: What would you like to write about?
journal.empty: No entries yet. Evening reviews and practices create them automatically.
journal.noResults: Nothing found. As the Stoics would say: “This is not up to me.”

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks. Empty is order too.
tasks.reactionPh: Your response to what is outside your control…

guide.title: Practice guide
guide.subtitle: Stoic exercises — from the dichotomy of control to the evening review. Practice, don't just read.

settings.title: More
settings.streakNote: A miss is not a failure. Coming back is practice too.
settings.deleteHint: All entries, tasks and logs will be erased permanently. Type your email to confirm.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete the account and all data permanently?
settings.about: Stoa — a stoic daily companion: morning ritual, tasks with the dichotomy of control, journal and evening review. A learning project: Next.js + Supabase. Version 0.1.0.
